_readme: Bottle shells cut from the Gemini sheets in Design/scene/shells/ (Plan 15). `sources` lists each sheet with the size it had when the crops were measured (the build warns, W29, if a sheet changes size or a crop leaves it: re-measure with build/tools/measure_shell_cells.py and re-derive the polygons with derive_shell_masks.py). Per shell: `source` (a key of `sources`), `crop` [x0, y0, x1, y1] in sheet pixels, whose bottom edge is the base line where the glass meets the shelf (the floor glow below is cut off); `maskPolygon` the silhouette in crop pixels (the build trusts it, so edit its points by hand to fix a cut); `mode` opaque (solid mask) or glass (luminance alpha, the shelf glow shows through); `labelSheet` the blank label in sheet pixels (on a glass shell it is forced fully opaque); `labelBlend` multiply for a paper label, normal for print on a can; `scale` the hand-set relative size (1.0 = a 720 ml sake); `shadow` the contact shadow as fractions of the shell. `spare: true` shells are cut but no drink uses them by default.
